title: The First Blade
tagline: One blade of grass. The Tao does nothing, and nothing is left undone.

stillness.note: Acting spends stillness. Everything that grows, grows at floor + (1 - floor) × stillness. The more you do, the less gets done.

ship.name: The rains
ship.note: The rains come when they come, every 584 days, and nothing you do hurries them. The clouds gather 292 days before they break; what they carry is settled then. They bring what the meadow cannot make: rain, and the creatures that follow it.

resources.name: grass
resources.desc: One blade, then the meadow. It grows by itself if you let it.

resources.name: soil
resources.desc: What grass becomes when it dies back. Everything is built on it.

resources.name: rain
resources.desc: Cannot be made. The sky gives it or does not.

resources.name: water
resources.desc: The highest good is like water. The ground holds the rain and lets it out slowly, nine to one.

resources.name: wood
resources.desc: From the grove. Slow, and worth waiting for.

resources.name: stone
resources.desc: Uncarved. Water wears it; the rains carry it.

resources.name: creatures
resources.desc: Frogs, birds, deer, foxes. They drink, they graze, and some things need them.

resources.name: te
resources.desc: Virtue: the power of the Way, found by sitting still. Buys sayings.

machines.name: Open sky
machines.desc: Sun on the grass, half the day.

machines.name: Dying back
machines.desc: Grass into soil. Nothing is wasted.

machines.name: Bare ground
machines.desc: Room for the next thing. +300 ground.

machines.name: The spring
machines.desc: The ground holds the rain and lets it out. One of rain, nine of water.

machines.name: The river bends
machines.desc: +800 ground on the inside of the curve, and the river drinks a little rain to keep it.

machines.name: The grove
machines.desc: Trees, in time. Birds carry the seed.

machines.name: The uncarved block
machines.desc: What grass becomes given time enough. Stone, unshaped.

machines.name: The moon pool
machines.desc: Holds the day's light and gives it back at night.

machines.name: Reeds
machines.desc: They bend in the wind and are not broken. A little sun, always.

machines.name: The quiet pool
machines.desc: Sit by it. Te comes to whoever waits.

machines.name: The path
machines.desc: Wood laid down; feet wear the stone smooth.

machines.name: Silence
machines.desc: The name that can be named is not the name. Te, in quantity.

machines.name: The hoard
machines.desc: The dragon sleeps on what it keeps. +1500 ground under the wings.

machines.name: The longhouse
machines.desc: They cut, they burn, and the grass comes back thicker.

machines.name: The fairy ring
machines.desc: Mushrooms in a circle. The grass inside grows wrong, and fast.

machines.name: The scales
machines.desc: Ma'at weighs. The feather is the measure.

sectors.name: The first blade
sectors.desc: A tree that fills the arms grows from a tiny shoot. This is the shoot.

sectors.name: Water
sectors.desc: The highest good is like water. It benefits all things and does not compete.

sectors.name: The valley spirit
sectors.desc: The valley spirit never dies. It is the low place everything runs to. Ground ×1.25.

sectors.name: The empty hub
sectors.desc: Thirty spokes share one hub; it is the hole that makes the wheel useful. Everything ×1.25.

sectors.name: Returning to the root
sectors.desc: The ten thousand things rise and fall while the root stays. Needs water. The grove starts here.

sectors.name: The uncarved block
sectors.desc: When the block is carved it becomes useful. Left alone it becomes everything.

sectors.name: Daily decrease
sectors.desc: In the pursuit of the Way, every day something is dropped. Sayings cost ×0.9.

sectors.name: The soft overcomes the hard
sectors.desc: Nothing is softer than water and nothing wears stone better. The weather reaches you half as hard.

sectors.name: The thousand-li journey
sectors.desc: Begins beneath one's feet. The rains carry ×1.2.

sectors.name: The nameless
sectors.desc: The Way that can be spoken is not the Way. Te ×1.5, sayings cost ×0.8.

sectors.name: The small country
sectors.desc: Few people; they hear the dogs of the next village and never go. Creatures travel light: 100 to a seat.

sectors.name: Doing nothing
sectors.desc: The Tao does nothing, and nothing is left undone. Everything ×1.5. Opens the return.

research.name: The moon pool
research.desc: Opens the pool; the night runs at 40%

research.name: The Tao does nothing
research.desc: And nothing is left undone. Everything ×2

events.name: A dragon overhead
events.desc: Its shadow crosses the meadow. Sun ×0.3.

events.name: Longships on the river
events.desc: They land, they trample, they leave. Meadow ×0.4.

events.name: Lights in the grass
events.desc: The fae are dancing. Meadow ×3, and do not ask what it costs.

events.name: The weighing of the heart
events.desc: Anubis holds the scales; the feather is light today. Te ×3.

events.name: Grass fire
events.desc: Ash on the wind. Grove ×0.3, everything wants more sun.

milestones.text: A thousand blades. A meadow, if you squint.
A hundred thousand. The deer have found it.
Ten million. From the river to the forest.
Thirty. The fox and the hare have an arrangement.
All twelve chapters. Now do nothing.

playstyles.name: The dragon
playstyles.desc: It sleeps on what it keeps. Stillness returns ×1.5, acting does half; the hoard and the breath.

playstyles.name: The longship crew
playstyles.desc: They act. Acting ×4, the weather reaches you twice as hard; the longhouse.

playstyles.name: The fae
playstyles.desc: Glamour. Everything ×1.2, creatures need ×1.5; the fairy ring.

playstyles.name: The house of Ma'at
playstyles.desc: Order. Te ×1.5, sayings cost ×0.8; the scales.

prestige.name: Return to the root
prestige.note: Everything returns to the root. The meadow goes back to one blade and keeps what it learned. Points = √(total grass / 1M). Each point is +10% to everything, forever. Each return also keeps one saying close, and they stack.

becoming.note: The transformation of things. Ring 1 is scripted: blade, flower, acorn, sapling, oak, grove. Then the oak drops an acorn, a tree stands, and the next ring is rolled from templates. There is no last form.

forms.name: the blade
forms.text: nothing extra; it is the game you have

forms.name: the flower
forms.text: bees follow it: creatures arrive ×1.2 per rain

forms.name: the oak
forms.text: it holds: creatures need ×0.6, the weather reaches you ×0.5

forms.name: the grove
forms.text: everything ×1.3; the oak's own acorns are ripening

passives.text: it takes ground and gives it back
it does not move and you stop moving
the creatures do its work for it
it is pale enough to see by
it asks for nothing and gets it

twist.text: one form in three also asks for a quiet stretch: 100 days × ring without acting

forest.note: One tree for every ring closed. Trees are never lost, not even by returning to the root. The reliable part.

tiers.name: the forest that was here first

mycelium.note: A tribute to mycelium.html: the web under the forest. Fed by everything that rots and by a tithe of the grass each time the mushrooms fruit. Depth climbs on a log scale, a thousandfold a step, and does not stop.
names: a mind the size of the valley
the thing the forest grows on

avatar.note: The first blade, yours. Nothing on it looks back. Every field is a template: add an option here and it appears in the builder and on the bank.
